events.title: In association football , the defending champions Mexico win a record-extending 10th Gold Cup title after defeating the United States 2–1 in the final at the NRG Stadium in Houston , Texas, United States. 에드손 알바레스 is named the tournament's best player. (France 24)

In association football , English club 첼시 F.C. win the FIFA Club World Cup for the second time, defeating French club 파리 생제르맹 3–0 in the final . 첼시 winger 콜 파머 is awarded the tournament's Golden Ball . (FIFA)

In association football , the Nigerian women's team wins a record-extending 12th Africa Cup of Nations title after defeating the host nation Morocco 3–2 in the final. Nigerian forward Rasheedat Ajibade is named the tournament's best player. ( The Guardian )

In association football , England defeats Spain 3–1 on penalties in the UEFA Women's Euro final to win their second major football championship and successfully defending their title. Spain's Aitana Bonmatí is named the tournament's best player. (Reuters)

St Kilda defeats Melbourne by six points after trailing by 46 points at three-quarter-time. It is the biggest comeback from a three-quarter-time deficit in the history of the Australian Football League. Nasiah Wanganeen-Milera's heroics help St Kilda record greatest final quarter comeback in VFL/AFL history – ABC News (Australian Broadcasting Corporation)
